Next, a scanner checks all control units at once: often, an error in ABS or the comfort module explains what the driver complains about. Then, we inspect the car: lift, checking for play, inspection under load, measuring pressure and using an oscilloscope when necessary.

At the end, we show the cause on the car and explain clearly. If repair is needed, we provide an estimate immediately.

src/content/works/BMW 116D/index.md.964493327fda7e4b:
**BMW 116d u našem servisu u Beogradu.**

Ovog puta nam je stigao BMW 116d, kojem je bila potrebna sveobuhvatna tehnička provera i otklanjanje nekoliko kvarova. Kod BMW-a je važno razumeti karakteristike motora i pažljivo posmatrati svaku komponentu: ne menjamo samo delove, već istražujemo uzrok zbog kojeg dolaze do kvara.

**Koje radove smo izvršili na BMW 116d?**

1. **Zamena antifriza.** Izvršili smo zamenu rashladne tečnosti kako bismo obezbedili pravilan rad sistema hlađenja motora. Pravovremena zamena antifriza pomaže u zaštiti elemenata sistema od korozije, održava optimalnu temperaturu i prevencija pregrevanja motora.
2. **Podmazivanje EGR ventila u ispušnom sistemu.** Obavili smo servis podupornog ventila sistema recirkulacije ispušnih gasova, koji se nalazi u ispušnoj cevi. Ovaj deo učestvuje u regulaciji pritiska ispušnih gasova i radu EGR sistema na dizel motorima BMW. Vremenom se mehanizam može zaprljati, zapečati i raditi neispravno. Izvršili smo neophodno podmazivanje mehanizma ventila.
3. **Zamena nosača motora.** Zamenili smo istrošeni nosač motora BMW 116d. Nosači motora su odgovorni za učvršćenje pogonskog skupa i smanjenje prenosa vibracija na karoseriju vozila. Njihovo istrošenje može dovesti do pojačanih vibracija, neprijatnih osećaja u kabini i dodatnog opterećenja na druge komponente.
4. **Utvrđena potreba za zamenom dempfera obrtnog momenta.** Tokom servisa smo takođe ustanovili da će automobilu biti potrebna dalja zamena dempfera obrtnog momenta radilice. Ovaj deo pomaže u prigušivanju oscilacija i obezbeđuje stabilan rad remenice dodatne opreme. Odlaganje zamene istrošenog dempfera se ne preporučuje, jer njegovo oštećenje može dovesti do dodatnih kvarova i skupih popravki.
src/content/works/BMW 116D/index.md.f2dc489ea00d07c0:
**BMW 116d at our car service in Belgrade.**

This time, we had a BMW 116d come in for comprehensive maintenance and to address several issues. It’s crucial to understand the specifics of the engines in BMWs and to examine every detail carefully. We don’t just replace parts; we identify the underlying causes of their failure.

**What work did we perform on the BMW 116d?**

1. **Coolant replacement.** We replaced the coolant to ensure the proper functioning of the engine's cooling system. Timely coolant replacement helps protect system components from corrosion, maintain optimal temperature levels, and prevent engine overheating.
2. **Lubrication of the EGR pressure valve in the exhaust system.** We serviced the EGR pressure valve located in the exhaust pipe. This component plays a role in regulating back pressure of exhaust gases and the functioning of the EGR system on BMW diesel engines. Over time, the mechanism can become dirty, seize up, and function improperly. We provided the necessary lubrication for the valve mechanism.
3. **Engine mount replacement.** We replaced the worn engine mount on the BMW 116d. Engine mounts are responsible for securing the powertrain and reducing vibration transfer to the vehicle body. Their wear can lead to increased vibrations, discomfort inside the cabin, and added strain on other components.
4. **Identified the need to replace the torsional vibration damper.** During the service, we also determined that the vehicle would require a future replacement of the crankshaft's torsional vibration damper. This component helps dampen vibrations and ensures stable operation of the accessory drive belt. Delaying the replacement of a worn damper is not advisable, as its failure could lead to additional malfunctions and costly repairs.

src/content/works/audi-a3/index.md.07be1c6b9ef4c632:
Audi A3 sa benzinskim **1.5 TFSI od 150 KS** i robotizovanom transmisijom DQ200 došao je u naš nezavisni auto servis u Beogradu na veliki servis. Zamenili smo zupčasti remen prednjeg dela motora.

Na osnovu rezultata dijagnostike, zamenjena je i električna pumpa sistema hlađenja. To je poseban sklop, a zamena se ne povezuje sa velikim servisom ili zupčastim remenom. Dijagnostika je pokazala da je pumpa izgubila kapacitet i više ne doprema rashladnu tečnost kako treba, a nismo hteli da čekamo da se to odrazi na temperaturu motora. Novi antifriz je stavljen nakon radova.

Paralelno smo uradili i mali servis: motorno ulje i sve potrebne filtre.

Sledeće je transmisija. DQ200 je robot sa suvim spojnicama, njemu je zamenjeno ulje u mehaničkom delu i radna tečnost u mehatronici. Preporuka za ovu transmisiju je jednostavna: i ulje i mehatroniku servisirati ne ređe od **60 000 km**. Na takvom intervalu sklop traje duže i ređe dolazi na skupu popravku.

src/content/works/audi-a3/index.md.4dccab412605a2cb:
The Audi A3 with a **1.5 TFSI engine producing 150 hp** and a DQ200 dual-clutch transmission came into our Russian auto service in Belgrade for a major service. We replaced the timing belt.

During the diagnostics, we also replaced the cooling system electric water pump. This is an independent unit that is not connected to the timing belt service. The diagnostics indicated that the pump was losing efficiency and was no longer circulating the coolant properly, and we didn’t want to wait for this to impact the engine's temperature management. We filled it with new antifreeze after the job.

In parallel, we performed a minor service: changing the engine oil and all necessary filters.

Next up was the transmission. The DQ200 is a dry-clutch automatic, and we changed the oil in the mechanical part and the fluid in the mechatronics. Our simple recommendation for this transmission is to service both the oil and mechatronics at least once every **60,000 km**. At this interval, the unit lasts longer and requires costly repairs less frequently.

src/content/works/bmw-118-d/index.md.f1c87824ae359949:
BMW 118d sa dizel motorom N47 i pređenih oko **380 000 km** stigao je u naš autoservis u Beogradu. Kao što je vlasnik kupio auto u Danskoj, odmah je započeo sa kompletnim servisom i rešavanjem problema koji su se već pojavili. Ovo je pravi redosled akcija nakon kupovine.

Započeli smo s celokupnim malim servisom: motorno ulje i svi filteri - filter za ulje, vazduh, kabinu i gorivo. Za N47, filter goriva je posebna priča: stanje gorivne jedinice direktno utiče na to koliko ravno motor radi i koliko će trajati njegovi sastavni delovi.

Nakon toga, proverili smo ovjes i kočnice. Zamenili smo elastične manžete, kočione diskove i pločice. Na polovnom automobilu sa velikim prevoženim kilometrima, kočnice su na prvom mestu za proverenje, i ovde je bilo potrebno da zamenimo istrošene delove kako bismo omogućili mirnu vožnju.

Otkrili smo curenje na zadnjem diferencialu, zamenili brtvu i zaustavili gubitak podmazivanja. Na automobilima s ovakvim pređenim kilometrima, diferencijal, brtve i ostatak prenosa zahtevaju posebnu pažnju.

Na 380 000 km, lista radova se ne završava jednim posetom. Auto ćemo postepeno dovoditi u red: potpuna dijagnostika, određivanje prioriteta, zatim redom motor, kočioni sistem, ovjes i prenos. Ovo je postupak koji savetujemo nakon kupovine polovnog automobila.

Dizeli N47 su našim majstorima dobro poznati. Uz redovno održavanje, ovakva kilometraža za motor nije kraj, ali nije dopušteno odlagati otkrivene probleme i preskočiti intervale.
src/content/works/bmw-118-d/index.md.fc179656328ad80b:
A BMW 118d with an N47 diesel engine and a mileage of around **380,000 km** arrived at our car service in Belgrade. The vehicle was brought from Denmark, and the owner recently purchased it, starting off with a complete service and addressing existing issues. This is the right course of action after a purchase.

We began with a full minor service: motor oil and all filters - oil, air, cabin, and fuel. The fuel filter for the N47 is a separate matter; the condition of the fuel system directly affects how smoothly the engine operates and how long its components will last.

Next, we focused on the suspension and brakes. We replaced the flexible gaiters, brake discs, and pads. For a used car with high mileage, brakes are checked first, and in this case, the worn components had to be replaced to ensure safe driving.

We found a leak in the rear differential, replaced the seal, and stopped the loss of lubricant. Vehicles with such mileage require special attention to the differential, seals, and the rest of the transmission.

At 380,000 km, the list of services cannot be completed in one visit. We will bring the car up to standard gradually: a full diagnostic, setting priorities, then tackling the engine, braking system, suspension, and transmission in turn. This is precisely how we recommend proceeding after purchasing a used car.

Our technicians are well-acquainted with N47 diesels. With proper maintenance, such mileage is not a death sentence for the engine, but it is crucial to address any issues found without delay and adhere to maintenance intervals.

A BMW came into our independent car service in Belgrade for maintenance of the cooling system and engine preventative care.

We performed a partial coolant replacement. On **B47** engines, a partial replacement typically requires **5–7 liters**. This time, we used Valvoline's green HT-12 coolant.

src/content/works/bmw-x3/index.md.9900486d9cf45f45:
Danas smo u našem servisu u Beogradu obavljali servis na BMW X3. Ovo je već drugo malo održavanje koje radimo na ovoj mašini.

Ovoga puta, klijent je zamolio da pored obične zamene ulja i filtera, promenimo i ulje u 8-stepenom automatskom menjaču **ZF**.

Na ovom menjaču menjamo ulje zajedno sa karterom: filter je ugrađen u karter, i proizvodi habanja sa zagađenjem se nakupljaju tamo. Zamena samo ulja ne predstavlja potpuno servisiranje takvog automatskog menjača.

U motor je sipano ulje sa odobrenjem **BMW Longlife-04** (BMW LL-04). Za BMW odobrenje je od suštinskog značaja.

Pogledali smo i vortex zaklopke na usisu. Za sada nema kritičnih problema, ali smo klijentu rekli da ih na sledećem malom održavanju treba skinuti i očistiti.

Today, we serviced a BMW X3 at our auto repair shop in Belgrade. This is the second minor service we have performed on this vehicle.

This time, the client requested not only the usual oil and filter change but also the oil change for the 8-speed automatic transmission **ZF**.

For this transmission, we replace the oil along with the oil pan: the filter is integrated into the pan, and contaminants accumulate there. Simply changing the oil alone does not constitute a complete service for this type of automatic transmission.

We used oil that meets the **BMW Longlife-04** (BMW LL-04) specification. Compliance with BMW standards is essential.

We also took a look at the swirl flaps in the intake. There are currently no critical issues, but we informed the client that during the next minor service, they should be removed and cleaned.

src/content/works/honda-accord/index.md.076c52255fd01bad:
Honda Accord sa benzinskim motorom dovezena je u naš autosenis u Beogradu na planirano tehničko održavanje.

Zamenili smo motorno ulje i osnovne filtere: vazdušni, uljni i filter habitacle. Postavili smo nove svećice — od njih zavisi kako radi benzinski motor, kako se pali i koliko troši.

Dodatno smo zamenili antifriz i kočionu tečnost: od njih zavisi radna temperatura motora i pouzdanost kočnica.

### Koliko često menjati ulje u Honda Accord?

Za benzinski Accord preporučujemo interval od otprilike **7 500 km**. Ulje gubi svoja svojstva postepeno, i na tom intervalu motor dobija sveže ulje pre nego što staro prestane da radi kako treba.

Pored ulja, na održavanju vredi obratiti pažnju na filtere, svećice, antifriz, kočionu tečnost i ostale potrošne materijale.
src/content/works/honda-accord/index.md.0a0dfd1293ee0f96:
A Honda Accord with a gasoline engine came into our car service in Belgrade for routine maintenance.

We replaced the engine oil and the main filters: air, oil, and cabin filter. We also installed new spark plugs, which are crucial for the smooth operation of the gasoline engine, its starting performance, and fuel efficiency.

Additionally, we changed the coolant and brake fluid, as they are essential for maintaining the engine's operating temperature and brake reliability.

### How often should you change the oil in a Honda Accord?

For the gasoline Accord, we recommend an interval of about **7,500 km**. Oil gradually loses its properties, and at this interval, the engine gets fresh oil before the old oil stops functioning properly.

Besides oil, it's also important during maintenance to check filters, spark plugs, coolant, brake fluid, and other consumables.

**Peugeot 208 1.2 PureTech. Major service, minor service, and gearbox oil change in Belgrade**\
A Peugeot 208 with a 1.2 PureTech gasoline engine came into our garage in Zvezdara. The vehicle required comprehensive maintenance, so we performed a major service, a minor service, and an oil change for the gearbox.\
As part of the major service, we replaced the timing belt and necessary components, as well as the water pump. The 1.2 PureTech engine does not have the water pump driven by the timing belt, but we recommend replacing it during major servicing. If you decide to keep the old pump, we highly recommend at least replacing the smaller belt that drives it.\
Particular attention should be paid to the timing belt replacement intervals for the 1.2 PureTech engines. Based on updated recommendations and the characteristics of these engines, we suggest performing a major service every 60,000 km, without waiting for issues with the belt to arise. The exact schedule should be verified for each specific engine modification.\
Our garage is equipped with all the necessary specialized tools for properly conducting major services on Peugeot and Citroën 1.2 PureTech engines. All work is performed in accordance with the technology for installing and securing the camshaft timing.\
In addition, we conducted a minor service that included an engine oil and filter change, and we completely replaced the gearbox oil using Valvoline oil.

**Peugeot 208 1.2 PureTech. Veliki i mali servis, zamena ulja u menjaču u Beogradu**\
U naš servis na Zvezdari je stigao Peugeot 208 sa benzinskim motorom 1.2 PureTech. Automobilu je bila potrebna sveobuhvatna tehnička proverka, pa smo obavili veliki servis (veliki servis), mali servis (mali servis) i zamenu ulja u menjaču.\
U okviru velikog servisa zamenili smo GRA remen i potrebne delove, kao i vodenu pumpu. Na motoru 1.2 PureTech pumpa se ne pokreće GRA remenom, ali preporučujemo da je zamenite tokom velikog servisa. Ako se odlučite da zadržite staru pumpu, obavezno preporučujemo da zamenite barem mali remen koji je pokreće.\
Posebnu pažnju treba obratiti na intervale zamene GRA remena na motorima 1.2 PureTech. Uzimajući u obzir ažurirane preporuke i karakteristike ovih motora, savetujemo da se veliki servis obavlja na svakih 60 000 km, ne čekajući pojavu problema sa remenom. Tačan plan održavanja treba proveriti za konkretni model motora.\
Naš servis ima sve neophodne specijalizovane alate za pravilno obavljanje velikog servisa na motorima Peugeot i Citroën 1.2 PureTech. Svi radovi se izvode uz poštovanje tehnologije postavljanja i fiksiranja faza razvodnog mehanizma.\
Dodatno, obavili smo mali servis sa zamenom motornog ulja i filtera, kao i potpunom zamenom ulja u menjaču, koristeći ulje Valvoline.

U našoj auto-servisnoj radnji u Beogradu izvršen je veliki redovni servis na **Skoda Octavia 2.0 TDI**. U Srbiji se ovakav paket radova naziva *veliki servis*. Na ovom dizelu se nalazi zupčasti kaiš GRM, i treba ga menjati prema propisima. Propuštena zamena kaiša ili drugih delova pogona dovodi do ozbiljnih kvarova motora i skupih popravki. Postavljen je kompletan set GRM **Continental** — sve u jednom potezu:
  • kaiš GRM
  • napenjač
  • vodena pumpa
Najčešće je ovakav redovni servis potreban nakon kupovine polovnog automobila, kada se ništa pouzdano ne zna o prethodnoj zameni kaiša, pumpe i valjaka.

Volkswagen Golf 2017. godine sa 7-stepenom robotizovanom transmisijom **DSG DQ381** došao je u naš aut servis u Beogradu na kompletnu tehničku proveru i rešavanje nekoliko kvarova.

Tokom servisiranja zamenili smo poklopac ventila zbog curenja ulja, obavili smo zamenu brtvi na injektorima, izvršili malo redovno održavanje motora, zamenili ulje i filter u DSG transmisiji, kao i očistili kočione čeljusti.

Posebnu pažnju smo posvetili DSG DQ381 transmisiji. Ovo je savremena 7-stepena menjačka sklopka sa dva kvačila, za koju je važno pravovremeno menjati ulje i filter: vremenom ulje gubi svoja svojstva, u njemu se nakupljaju proizvodi trošenja, što utiče na rad mehatronike, hidrauličkog sistema i kvačila. Redovna zamena ulja održava glatko prebacivanje brzina i smanjuje rizik od skupih popravki DSG-a.

Za transmisiju smo ulili transmisijsko ulje **MOTUL** potrebne specifikacije, a u motor smo takođe ulili MOTUL. Kvalitet motornog i transmisijskog ulja direktno utiče na to koliko će automobil trajati.

Tokom malog redovnog održavanja zamenili smo motorno ulje i potrebne filtere: za turbomotore Volkswagen, pravovremena zamena ulja je posebno važna, jer podmazuje delove, odvodi toplotu i štiti turbinu od preuranjenog trošenja.

Zamenili smo poklopac ventila, jer je stari počeo da propušta ulje: takva curenja vremenom se pojačavaju i dovode do zagađenja motora. Ujedno smo zamenili brtve na injektorima: hermetičnost spojeva je važna za bezbedan rad sistema za gorivo.

Očistili smo i kočione čeljusti od zagađenja i korozije: zapečeni pokretni elementi izazivaju neravnomerno trošenje pločica, pregrevanje diskova i čudne zvuke prilikom kočenja.

A 2017 Volkswagen Golf with a 7-speed dual-clutch transmission **DSG DQ381** arrived at our garage in Belgrade for comprehensive maintenance and to address several issues.

During the service, we replaced the valve cover due to an oil leak, resealed the fuel injectors, performed a minor engine service, changed the oil and filter in the DSG transmission, and also cleaned the brake calipers.

We focused particular attention on the DSG DQ381 transmission. This modern 7-speed gearbox with dual clutches requires timely oil and filter changes; over time, the oil degrades and accumulates wear particles, which affects the performance of the mechatronics, hydraulic system, and clutches. Regular oil changes ensure smooth gear shifts and reduce the risk of costly DSG repairs.

We filled the transmission with the appropriate specification of **MOTUL** transmission oil, and the engine was also filled with MOTUL. The quality of the engine and transmission oils directly affects the lifespan of the vehicle.

As part of the minor service, we replaced the engine oil and necessary filters: for turbocharged Volkswagen engines, timely oil changes are especially crucial as they lubricate components, dissipate heat, and protect the turbocharger from premature wear.

The valve cover was replaced because the old one began to leak oil; such leaks tend to worsen over time and lead to engine contamination. We also resealed the fuel injectors, as the integrity of the connections is essential for the safe operation of the fuel system.

Additionally, we cleaned the brake calipers from dirt and corrosion: stuck moving parts cause uneven wear of the pads, overheating of the discs, and unwanted noises during braking.

Zamena ulja u **DSG DQ381** je deo servisa menjača koji nikako ne bi trebalo zanemariti.

Ovaj put smo radili redovnu zamenu: klijent je izabrao ulje **MEYLE**, sipali smo ga i izvršili ostale potrebne servise.

DQ381 je moderni sedmostepeni DSG menjač sa mokrim kuplungom, koji se koristi u mnogim Volkswagen, Audi, Škoda i SEAT modelima. Ako se redovno servisira, ovaj menjač traje dugo i bez ozbiljnih problema.

Sa drugim popularnim DSG menjačima, DQ250 i DQ200, situacija je slična. Iako imaju različitu konstrukciju i propise, stanje ulja i pravovremeni servis direktno utiču na životni vek menjača, rad mehatronike i kuplunga.

Preporučujemo da se orijentišete ne samo na formalne servise, već i na stvarne uslove korišćenja. Ako ne znate istoriju servisa vozila, ne bi trebalo voziti na istom ulju 100–150 hiljada kilometara. Svakih **100 000 km** ima smisla proveriti kada i kako je menjač servisiran, a za DQ381 i DQ250 ulje obično treba menjati znatno ranije.

Sveže, kvalitetno ulje održava potrebna svojstva pri različitim temperaturama i opterećenjima, podmazuje i odvodi toplotu. Na taj način se skupi popravak odlaže.

Kupili ste polovni automobil i ne znate kada je poslednji put servisiran DSG DQ381, DQ250 ili DQ200 — proverite stanje menjača i njegovu istoriju unapred.
src/content/works/zamena-masla-v-dsg-dq-.0d35a28dcb3da77b: Zamena ulja u DSG DQ381 na Skoda Octavia
src/content/works/zamena-masla-v-dsg-dq-.be5bd00482a2cedf:
Changing oil in the **DSG DQ381** is an important part of transmission maintenance that should not be overlooked.

This time we performed a scheduled oil change: the client chose **MEYLE** oil, we filled it up and completed the rest of the necessary service.

The DQ381 is a modern seven-speed DSG automatic transmission with wet clutches, used in many Volkswagen, Audi, Škoda, and SEAT models. When maintained on time, this transmission lasts long and without serious issues.

The same goes for other common DSG models, the DQ250 and DQ200. While they differ in design and specifications, the condition of the oil and timely maintenance directly influence the longevity of the transmission, the function of the mechatronics, and the clutches.

We recommend considering not only the formal maintenance schedule but also the actual operating conditions. If the maintenance history is unknown, it is definitely not advisable to run the oil for 100,000–150,000 kilometers. At **100,000 km**, it makes sense to at least check when and how the transmission was serviced, and for both the DQ381 and DQ250, the oil usually should be changed much sooner.

Fresh, high-quality oil maintains its essential properties under various temperatures and loads, lubricates, and dissipates heat. This helps to avoid costly repairs in the long run.

If you purchased a used car and are unsure when the DSG DQ381, DQ250, or DQ200 was last serviced, check the condition of the transmission and its service history in advance.
